input.quote: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule but without additional fees or charges, Garman shall provide the following Maintenance Services:
input.rationale: Maintenance runs for a "renewable one-year term" but the Agreement never states how renewal occurs, gives no non-renewal notice window or renewal reminder, and (with Sections 11 and 17 simply pointing to the Fee Schedule) leaves renewal-term maintenance fees uncapped. The playbook requires renewals to be easy to exit and predictably priced, so we added 12-month renewal terms that Sparkling may decline on 30 days' notice, a 60-day Garman reminder, and a cap of the lesser of CPI and 3% on any renewal uplift; fallback is a 60-day window and 5% cap.

ops.oldText: For a renewable one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date, subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule
ops.newText: For an initial one-year term commencing upon the Maintenance Commencement Date and for successive twelve (12) month renewal terms thereafter (provided that Sparkling may elect not to renew by written notice to Garman given at least thirty (30) calendar days before the end of the then-current term, and Garman shall notify Sparkling of the upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) calendar days before the end of the then-current term), subject to payment of maintenance fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule (which fees shall not increase for any renewal term by more than the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the prior term and three percent (3%))

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 makes maintenance a "renewable one-year term" without specifying how renewal happens or limiting the renewal fee, so we have added 12-month renewals that we can decline on 30 days' notice, a 60-day reminder from Garman, and an uplift cap of the lesser of CPI and 3%. If the cap is an issue we can accept a 5% ceiling with a 60-day non-renewal notice window.
proposal.summary: Add renewal mechanics and a cap on maintenance fee uplift for renewal terms of Maintenance Services
